status: Exploratory lumped-resistance model; not a PCB or force qualification
notes: The resistance cases have no assigned force; there is no R-versus-newtons measurement.
A local row branch runs to each of six patches; global row drivers are shared.
Nonselected columns float. The selected column is held near bias through a finite path resistance.
Compare floating inactive rows with inactive rows driven to the same ideal bias.
The active/readout bias is shifted to zero for the linear calculation; a physical single-supply implementation would use a positive common-mode voltage.
This model omits in-plane film spreading, contact mechanics, amplifier offset/leakage, capacitance, ADC behavior and temperature.
Path resistances are exploratory assumptions. Component and tail limits must be verified before selecting a build circuit.
The 1% electrical-interaction screen is an engineering work criterion, not the 1% physical contact-error requirement.
